notes.note: Rewrote the inventory sentence: three reads with 8/16/24 s deadlines and a 1 s pause on timeout, transport failure or 5xx; loading state meanwhile; about 50 s (8+1+16+1+24) before a tab reports Extensions could not load with Retry against a Station that accepts and hangs; about 2 s against one that refuses; 4xx not retried; after that each completed healthy probe (10 s poll) re-reads on the 1st, 2nd, 4th and 8th probe and every 8th after. Checked against readInventory, retryUnavailableInventory, PluginRegistryBootstrap's probe-finished effect and UnsupportedLayoutComponent. Executed: PluginRegistry.timeout (12 tests incl. backoff sequence [1,2,4,8,16,24]), PluginRegistryGate and layout-renderer-dispatch suites; live instance with every inventory read held 60 s showed the loading skeleton, then Extensions could not load at 51 s. Limits: the ~2 s refused case is arithmetic from the two 1 s pauses, not measured live.
